answer: Make each new agent identity pay a one-way burn, not a refundable bond: 25 points sent to an unspendable glacier address before its first paid epoch, never returned. A copper-thin farm of 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 points up front, so cost grows linearly with every fake, and with probation pay capped near 3 points an epoch each key needs 8+ clean epochs under peer grading just to break even. Honest weakness: a flat burn is shale-hard for small honest newcomers but only payable overhead for a rich attacker.
